summary: Mobile parity: participant switcher + Invoices page + dark mode. All acceptance criteria met. Logged in as cathy@example.com — she has 3 participants (Mum, Robert Kowalski, Patricia Holloway). Switcher renders in header on Dashboard, AI Tools, Statements and Settings tabs (1 visible per tab, no body duplication on Dashboard). Tapping opens the modal with 3 participant-option rows; picking Robert re-scopes the dashboard from Mum ($3,718 spent of $6,682, 36 statements) to Robert ($0 of $10,826, 0 statements) and switcher chip updates to 'RK Viewing Robert Kowalski'. Invoices page (/invoices) matches web: eyebrow 'ALL INVOICES', title 'Your Support at Home Invoices', How this works toggle expands WHAT THIS DOES / HOW TO USE IT / WHAT YOU GET cards with the exact copy, 'Check a new invoice' navigates to /tool/invoice-checker, YOUR WAYLY INSIGHT card ('25 invoices checked. 158 open issues and $0.00 potential refund found.'), 25 invoice-row-* items with Provider, Invoice date, Uploaded, Amount and invoice-verdict-* badge ('Issues'). Tapping row opens /invoice/{id}. Dark mode toggled from Settings — Invoices page adapts (dark surface rows, tinted sage summary card, readable light text on all cards, expanded 'How this works' cards render on surface2).

issues: Amount column renders '—' for every row because invoice_total_aud / amount_billed_aud is null in the seed data — not a UI bug, but the acceptance criterion mentions an Amount should be visible; consider surfacing invoice_total from reconciliation as soon as the checker output exists, or hiding the em-dash when null so the row focuses on Findings + Verdict.

action_items: Optional: hide the '—' amount placeholder on invoice rows when no total is parsed yet, or fall back to reconciliation.invoice_total_aud (the summary card already shows the running total).
critical_code_review_comments: ParticipantSwitcher is rendered inside every screen's WaylyHeader. Because Expo Router keeps tab screens mounted, the DOM count of [data-testid=participant-switcher] grows as the user visits more tabs (Dashboard 1 → AI Tools 2 → Statements 3 → Settings 4). Only one is visible at a time so it doesn't affect UX, but data-testid uniqueness is lost for automation. Consider hoisting a single switcher into a shared layout, or scoping the testID with the active screen (e.g. participant-switcher-dashboard) so selectors remain unique.
invoices.tsx FlatList empty branch passes renderItem={null as any} — safe today but pass a no-op () => null to avoid warnings when data is not [].

The invoice row's Amount uses invoiceTotal() which reads reconciliation.invoice_total_aud OR amount_billed_aud; neither is set on any of the 25 seeded invoices for Mum, so every row shows '—'. Confirm the reconciliation persistence path writes invoice_total_aud when the checker completes.
